articles.title: AstraZeneca-Hutchmed drug combination shows promise in advanced lung cancer study
articles.description: Sept 1 () - AstraZeneca and China's Hutchmed said on Tuesday that a late-stage trial of ‌a combination of their cancer drugs Tagrisso ‌and Orpathys significantly improved progression-free survival when given early for a ​type of lung cancer. Cancer therapies make up nearly half of AstraZeneca's sales and Tagrisso is one of its best-selling drugs, while Orpathys is being developed along ‌with Hutchmed as ⁠the British drugmaker pursues its goal of $80 billion in overall annual sales by 2030.
